limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Verified procurement/policy state changes with defense-sector relevance: US troop posture in Europe, Senate defense bill, Malaysian cyber budget, India-Indonesia/Somalia cooperation, Philippine deal, Danish package, Norway export decision, Boeing cash guidance. Filters out sports 'defense' items.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Verified official/forecast output data: euro-area GDP, China GDP miss and youth unemployment, IMF/Fitch/Goldman forecasts, recession gauges, Bangladesh data overstatement, Baltic/European GDP divergence. Excludes stock-picking and small-company orders.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Material global energy transmission: supply-surplus price slide, IEA emergency releases amid diesel shortage, major LNG/oil deals, tanker attack near Hormuz, Russian sanctions. Avoids local retail prices and promotional content.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Only five distinct candidates with material stability relevance: Bundesbank warning, private-credit default concerns, AT-1 bond litigation, municipal bond default risk, cyber systemic-risk aggregation. Excludes blood-bank, horoscope, personal loan and promotional items.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Verified regulatory/policy actions: CMS Medicaid work-requirement delay and state divergences, 2027 physician fee schedule, EMA CHMP decisions, federal Medicaid reimbursement denial, facility decertification, FDA feedback on drug, Medicaid-cut political push. Excludes personal Medicare advice and fraud anecdotes.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified state changes with global oil/shipping/energy transmission: UK sanctions on Russian oil producers, new EU bank sanctions, Houthi arms-embargo extension, Ukraine strikes on Russian oil infrastructure, Gulf/Iran escalation. Prioritizes authoritative state actions and corroborated reports; excludes speculation and local-only incidents.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Authoritative central-bank and CPI signals across major economies (Fed, BoE, ECB, RBI, Hungary, US, UK) and shifting market narrative from inflation to growth. Excludes individual-company, IRS-adjustment and speculative items.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Material shocks with possible market/regional transmission: US shutdown brinkmanship, post-election AI-stock plunge, Solomon Islands earthquake, Russia dam-burst evacuation, South Sudan election delay, Aceh/Kenya flooding, Florida hurricane surge, federal election-related court order. Excludes routine wildfire planning and local crime.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Genuine bullion-market signals: inflation-driven price swings and rebound, India gold-import-driven trade deficit, Pakistan price decline, Guinea mining ban deaths, KP mining ban, UAE smuggling report, analyst forecasts/target cuts. Filters out sports, obituaries and culture 'gold/silver' references.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Material industry/market transmission: Nvidia chip diversion to China, chip-stock selloff, damage to Russian data centers, Intel-Amazon foundry deal, data-center power-cost rules, and data-center siting/regulatory shifts. Excludes single-product launches and hype.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: State-level tariff/export-control actions with global scope: US-China tariff cuts, polysilicon tariffs, EU-US Airbus dispute, Norwegian salmon relief, EV tariff delays, Nvidia export controls. Excludes opinion, lobbying and consumer tips.
